seoTitle: Top End Marketing Agency | Local SEO | GT Marketing
seoDescription: Darwin-based local SEO, websites and lead generation for small and medium businesses across the Top End of the Northern Territory.

hero.heading: Local marketing across the
hero.intro: GT Marketing is based in Darwin and helps small and medium businesses across the Top End with local SEO, websites and lead-generation systems. We do not claim an office outside Darwin City.

servicesHeading: The same practical offer, set up for businesses outside the CBD.
servicesIntro: Top End businesses still need to be found when someone nearby searches, and they still need a website that makes the next step obvious. Distance does not change that. It just means most of the work can be done from Darwin.

services.title: Local SEO
services.description: Google Business Profile, service-area pages and the on-page basics so searches for your trade or service can find you.

services.title: Websites
services.description: A clear site that says what you do, where you work, and how to call or book. Built to be looked after without a large marketing team.

services.title: Lead generation
services.description: A simple path from the enquiry to a reply, so calls, forms and messages do not sit unanswered.

services.title: Tradies
services.description: Electricians, plumbers, builders and other trade businesses that want local jobs, not a generic national campaign.

services.title: Hospitality
services.description: Cafes, restaurants and venues that need to show up locally and make booking or visiting straightforward.

services.title: Health and professional services
services.description: Clinics, NDIS providers and professional firms that need a clear offer and a trusted way for people to make contact.

localHeading: Darwin is the office. The Top End is a service area.
localParagraphs: GT Marketing is at 130 Smith Street, Darwin City. Katherine, the rural area and other Top End towns are places we can work with, not extra offices.
Projects are usually run from Darwin by phone, video and shared documents. Travel can be added when it is useful and the cost is agreed first.
We do not promise rankings or a set number of leads. The scope is agreed before work starts.
industriesHeading: Businesses we can help across the Top End
serviceAreaNote: Coverage depends on the project. GT Marketing does not claim offices outside Darwin City.

faqs.question: Do you have an office in the Top End outside Darwin?
faqs.answer: No. The only office is 130 Smith Street, Darwin City. Other Top End places are service areas.

faqs.question: Can you work with a business outside Darwin?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most projects are handled from Darwin. If a visit would help, we agree the timing and travel cost before it is booked.

faqs.question: What do you actually set up?
faqs.answer: Local SEO, a website, and a lead-generation system suited to a small or medium business. The exact scope is agreed on a call.

closing.heading: Book a call with a Darwin agency that works across the Territory.
